name: Alternating incline dumbbell curl
instructions: Sit back on an inclined bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Let your arms hang at your sides.
Bend one elbow to lift the dumbbell, lower it, then repeat on the other side.

name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted. Hold the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chest, then press it back up.

name: Barbell curl
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms forward.
Bend your elbows to raise the bar. Keep your torso still as you lower it.

name: Barbell front squat
instructions: Support the bar across the front of your shoulders with your elbows lifted.
Bend at the hips and knees, keeping your chest up. Stand back up with the bar over your feet.

name: Barbell row
instructions: Hold the bar with an overhand grip. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward so the bar hangs below your shoulders.
Keep your torso steady as you draw the bar toward your lower ribs. Lower it under control.

name: Cable triceps pushdown
instructions: Attach a short bar to a high pulley and stand facing it. Hold the bar with your palms down.
Keep your elbows beside your torso. Press the bar down, then guide it back up.

Pull toward your upper chest with your elbows moving down. Control the return overhead.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet on the floor.
Lower the dumbbells beside your chest, then press them up together.

name: Dumbbell curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell at each side.
Turn your palms upward as you curl the weights. Slowly return them to your sides.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells by your sides and a slight bend at your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to about shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell wrist curl
instructions: Sit with your forearm supported on your thigh, palm up, and your hand just beyond the knee.
Curl the wrist upward while the forearm stays supported. Lower the dumbbell slowly.

name: Forearm plank
instructions: Rest your forearms on the floor with your elbows beneath your shoulders. Step your feet back to support yourself on your toes.
Hold your trunk steady in line with your legs. Record how long you maintain the position.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell at each side and your palms facing inward.
Keep that grip as you bend your elbows. Lower the dumbbells to the starting position.

name: Incline barbell bench press
instructions: Lie back on an inclined bench, plant your feet and hold the bar above your chest.
Lower the bar toward your upper chest, then press it upward.

name: Incline dumbbell bench press
instructions: Sit against an inclined bench with a dumbbell at each shoulder and your feet planted.
Press both weights upward, then lower them beside your upper chest.

name: Leg extension
instructions: Adjust the seat and position the roller above your ankles. Keep your back against the pad.
Straighten your knees to lift the roller, then lower it smoothly.
